neighbours.label: the word introducing what a value or rule depends on or applies across (depends on, regardless of, for men or women)
fire: The length of the course depends on how much time each student can give.
Insurance rates differ depending on age, driving record and location.
The museum is free for all visitors, regardless of where they live.
The target intake is 2 grams a day for boys or girls under twelve.
Whether the seeds sprout depends largely on the soil temperature.
Scholarships are awarded regardless of financial need.
Recovery time varies depending on the size of the wound.
The vaccine is offered to adults of any age, whether healthy or not.
quiet: The length of the course is twelve weeks and it ends in June.
Insurance rates went up last year across the whole country.
The museum is free for all visitors and opens at ten.
The target intake is 2 grams a day and most children reach it.
The seeds sprouted after a week in the warm soil.
Scholarships are awarded every spring at a small ceremony.
Recovery time was short and the wound closed quickly.
The vaccine is offered at the clinic on the main street.
